Data reaches this code through include/*.php class methods (mysql_* calls inside them), not through a query in this file. Every such read is therefore sourceKind 'unresolved', loops have iterSourceKind 'unresolved', and there is no queries entry. _provenance.locConvention: Member 01's convention (Q13-Q15, answered 12 Oct 2026): every sequence entry, loop and branch enclosure carries loc {startLine, endLine, startCol, endCol, startByte, endByte}, the loc of its AST node (for an enclosure: the node named by nodeId). _provenance.condExprConvention: Member 01's convention (Q2, answered 12 Oct 2026): every then/elseif branch enclosure carries condExpr, the exact source of its if/elseif `cond` node (no outer parentheses), and condNodeId is that node's id. else branches have no condExpr: their meaning comes from the chain.
